formula.expression:
lets(
  /* Create a combined location text to search in */
  location, (if(empty({{notion:block_property:IuLZ:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:7e0def65-baa5-81f6-bec7-00036d03ac77}}), "", {{notion:block_property:IuLZ:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:7e0def65-baa5-81f6-bec7-00036d03ac77}})) + " " + 
            (if(empty({{notion:block_property:nVFR:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:7e0def65-baa5-81f6-bec7-00036d03ac77}}), "", {{notion:block_property:nVFR:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:7e0def65-baa5-81f6-bec7-00036d03ac77}})),
  jobTitle, if(empty({{notion:block_property:title:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:7e0def65-baa5-81f6-bec7-00036d03ac77}}), "", lower({{notion:block_property:title:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:7e0def65-baa5-81f6-bec7-00036d03ac77}})),
  
  /* Classify into portfolios based on job title and location */
  ifs(
    /* RMS general classification */
    jobTitle.contains("rms"), 
    "RMS",
    
    /* MFC Air & Missile Defense */
    jobTitle.contains("pac3") or jobTitle.contains("pac-3") or 
    jobTitle.contains("patriot") or jobTitle.contains("mse") or 
    jobTitle.contains("thaad") or jobTitle.contains("air missile defense") or 
    jobTitle.contains("air & missile defense") or lower(location).contains("camden") or 
    lower(location).contains("grand prairie") or lower(location).contains("dallas"), 
    "MFC – Air & Missile Defense",
    
    /* MFC Precision Fires */
    jobTitle.contains("prsm") or jobTitle.contains("precision strike") or 
    jobTitle.contains("gmlrs") or jobTitle.contains("mlrs") or 
    jobTitle.contains("launcher"), 
    "MFC – Precision Fires",
    
    /* MFC Strike Weapons */
    jobTitle.contains("jassm") or jobTitle.contains("lrasm") or 
    jobTitle.contains("strike weapons") or jobTitle.contains("cruise") or 
    lower(location).contains("orlando") or lower(location).contains("troy"), 
    "MFC – Strike Weapons",
    
    /* MFC Other */
    jobTitle.contains("missiles and fire control") or jobTitle.contains("mfc"), 
    "MFC – Missiles & Fire Control",
    
    /* RMS Naval Systems */
    jobTitle.contains("aegis") or jobTitle.contains("gws") or 
    jobTitle.contains("guam weapon") or jobTitle.contains("naval systems") or 
    jobTitle.contains("sm-6") or jobTitle.contains("sm6") or 
    lower(location).contains("moorestown") or lower(location).contains("huntsville"), 
    "RMS – Naval Systems",
    
    /* LM Space Strategic & Missile Defense */
    jobTitle.contains("ngi") or jobTitle.contains("fbm") or 
    jobTitle.contains("trident") or jobTitle.contains("opir") or 
    jobTitle.contains("ngg") or jobTitle.contains("space") or 
    lower(location).contains("sunnyvale") or lower(location).contains("littleton") or 
    lower(location).contains("denver"), 
    "LM Space – Strategic & Missile Defense",
    
    /* Default classification */
    "Unclassified Portfolio"
  )
)
